messages:
anya: heads-up - ACME moved their private deploy up. need quick owner map for runtime tweaks, infra capacity, and security gating. can we list minimal blockers?

mike_p: i can own runtime changes (batching/kv-cache + quantization checklist). need expected qps and prompt length distro.

carlos: infra note: two reserved GPUs free mid-June but other pilots conflict. if they expect ~150 rps steady we should plan +1 GPU and a prewarm.

dena: product launch must hit: p95 <=100ms (<=512 tokens), throughput >=150 rps, audit logs (SIEM) eventually, and 3-customer canary.

rachel: security: KMS/HSM required. architecture review + pen test ~2 weeks. if we disable SIEM streaming for pilot we can reduce scope.

mike_p: for latency we can drop batching window to 20ms; prototype and bench by next Tue.

carlos: suggest cluster `private-june-1` (2 GPUs) + `private-june-burst` (+1). prewarm window 30m. will open infra ticket.

infra-bot: reminder - run `infra reserve private-june-1` to claim available window Jun 10-14.

dena: can we ship limited pilot without SIEM to speed up?

rachel: yes - internal audit logs only for pilot. still need KMS notes and data-flow doc.

mike_p: rollout plan: bench -> canary on `private-june-1` (SIEM off) -> A/B canary w/ hosted fallback -> GA + enable SIEM. i'll write checklist.

carlos: i'll draft failover runbook (route to hosted endpoints) and infra ticket.

anya: actions: mike_p bench+checklist by Tue; carlos open infra ticket + runbook by Fri; rachel file arch review by EoW; dena update roadmap + comms by Thu. i'll add these to the initiative card.

mike_p: product, please share ~30 representative prompts for QA by EOD tomorrow.

dena: will do.

anya: thanks all, scheduling checkpoint next Mon. :thumbsup:
